items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 1 at 10:14PM EDT until October 2 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Allendale, Charleston, Coastal Colleton, Dorchester,
Hampton, Inland Berkeley, Inland Colleton, and Tidal Berkeley
Counties.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 9 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
